integrity: Theorem is proved in RESULT.md with explicit exact moment matrices, strict global reflection reduction and analytic convexity; verify.py independently checks rational identities and brackets the unique optimum. Numerical displays are ancillary. Prior coverage has been compared but may not be exhaustively indexed. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact minimax edge selection for fixed iid pairwise averaging, only paths with at most four vertices and horizons one or two; larger graphs, longer horizons, adaptive laws and other norms are not classified. Generic exact-MSE identities and asymptotic design criteria are prior work, not claimed as new.
title: Two-step minimax edge sampling on the four-vertex path
